claims_attributed_to_sources.claim: NOAA describes 10.7 cm (2800 MHz) solar radio flux as a long-running solar-activity indicator, commonly reported in solar flux units.
The NOAA SWPC 30-day endpoint exposes dated F10.7 flux observations used for the self-contained 2026-11-02 Atlas time-series experiment.
Recent months of NOAA monthly solar indices may be preliminary; time-scoped analyses must not silently treat them as final.
